17	package org.springframework.samples.petclinic.util;
18	
19	import java.util.Collection;
20	
21	import org.springframework.orm.ObjectRetrievalFailureException;
22	import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.model.BaseEntity;
23	
24	/**
25	 * Utility methods for handling entities. Separate from the BaseEntity class mainly because of dependency on the
26	 * ORM-associated ObjectRetrievalFailureException.
27	 *
28	 * @author Juergen Hoeller
29	 * @author Sam Brannen
30	 * @see org.springframework.samples.petclinic.model.BaseEntity
31	 * @since 29.10.2003
32	 */
33	public abstract class EntityUtils {
34	
35	    /**
36	     * Look up the entity of the given class with the given id in the given collection.
37	     *
38	     * @param entities    the collection to search
39	     * @param entityClass the entity class to look up
40	     * @param entityId    the entity id to look up
41	     * @return the found entity
42	     * @throws ObjectRetrievalFailureException if the entity was not found
43	     */
44	    public static <T extends BaseEntity> T getById(Collection<T> entities, Class<T> entityClass, int entityId)
45	        throws ObjectRetrievalFailureException {
46	        for (T entity : entities) {
47	            if (entity.getId() == entityId && entityClass.isInstance(entity)) {
48	                return entity;
49	            }
50	        }
51	        throw new ObjectRetrievalFailureException(entityClass, entityId);
52	    }
53	
54	}

    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>'
                where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of city,
                LAST3 the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN a
                per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the
                number of owners already in that city at the time the owner was
                created.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners in the same household. Set
                when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true and an
                existing owner has the same lastName and address; both owners
                are then assigned this identifier.
              type: string
              example: '9e107d9d-372b-3f4a-8b4a-1d2c3e4f5a6b'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, shared the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). Counts only owners created before this one.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where <customerCode> is the owner's customer code and YY is the
                last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 3 assigned at
                creation: starting at 1, add 1 when an email is present and add 1
                when namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for
                tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city using the
                fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true

readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners
                had already been created for the same registration date; 'true'
                once that threshold is exceeded, otherwise 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key used for duplicate detection, formed as
